stemMd: Choose the best transition: "A traditional tide gauge measures water height at one point. ___, satellite measurements can cover large areas of ocean."
explanationMd: The sentences compare the spatial reach of two measurement methods. A contrast transition highlights one point versus large areas.

distractorRationale.c: The second method is not a restatement of the first.
distractorRationale.b: Wide satellite coverage is not a consequence of a gauge's point measurement.
distractorRationale.d: The first method's limitation does not establish the stated cause of satellite coverage.
